thread:
ravi: Heads-up 1: I opened a small PR to add a concise migration note and three terse SDK snippets (Python, C#, and Bash curl) that demonstrate batching + kv_prefetch + choosing a quant_profile. Also found two stale anchors in the old nav. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5567
cass: Drop the snippets here so I can sanity-check naming and casing (esp C# properties).
ravi: Python snippet:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
res = client.generate(
    model="rwd/opt-13b-q4",
    input="TL;DR:",
    batch_size=3,
    kv_prefetch=True,
    quant_profile="q4_256"
)
print(res.output)
```
ravi: C# snippet (tiny):
```csharp
using Redwood;
var client = new RedwoodClient();
var res = await client.GenerateAsync(new GenerateRequest {
    Model = "rwd/opt-13b-q4",
    Input = "TL;DR:",
    BatchSize = 3,
    KVPrefetch = true,
    QuantProfile = "q4_256"
});
Console.WriteLine(res.Output);
```
ravi: Curl example if folks want a minimal non-SDK way:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd/opt-13b-q4","input":"TL;DR:","batch_size":3,"kv_prefetch":true,"quant_profile":"q4_256"}'
```
cass: C# props look good. Small nit: the SDK team renamed `BatchSize` -> `Batching.BatchSize` in the latest major; suggest either show the flat shape or add a note. Maybe show both?
marco: For the doc text, let's not promise numbers. Use relative indicators and an example caveat. Proposed single-row summary for reader consumption: "q4_256: lower cost, small latency drop at batch>1; q8_512: higher quality for some workloads, higher cost." Keep it compact.
anya: Also add a short migration checklist under "Dedicated/Private": 1) pin quant_profile per model version, 2) run a 1% canary, 3) monitor eval prompts for drift.
ravi: Added the checklist to the PR description. For CLI users I kept the curl snippet minimal. cass: If we include the Batch grouping change, add a one-liner: "SDK v0.13+: Batch settings live under `Batching` namespace; older flat params still accepted for now."
doc-bot: LINT: detected broken anchor in optimize/quantization/index.md: `#best-practices` -> renamed. Suggest adding redirect entry.
doc-bot: SUGGEST: add mkdocs.yml redirects for `/optimize/quant-profiles` -> `/optimize/quantization/` and `/optimize/quant-profiles#best-practices` -> `/optimize/quantization/#recommendations`.
marco: Redirects make sense. Are there any external links pointing at the old anchors? We should add a quick search-and-replace in the repo.
ravi: I grepped and found 4 matches in the repo and two in third-party blog posts (we can't change those). I'll add the redirects to preserve links.
cass: Quick code review: Python/Curl ok. For C# maybe show both `res.Output` and `res.Text` note? People hit older examples.
ravi: Added a short compatibility note: "Older SDKs used `res.Text`; prefer `res.Output` in v0.12+. See SDK changelog."
marco: Can we merge without fixing the small anchor mention in the body? I think the redirect and snippets are the important bits. We'll follow up with a formatting pass.
anya: Create a follow-up issue so the crossref and example table formatting isn't lost.
ravi: Done: opened issue #866 for table/crossref + Batch namespace examples. Updated PR description to reference it.
doc-bot: CI: docs build OK after adding redirects. Preview: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/5567/ (shows snippets + migration checklist).
ravi: Merged. I'll monitor issue #866 and the preview for any rendering quirks. Thanks all.
